name: Tenstorrent Blackhole Emulator
description: A full-system Blackhole emulator built on QEMU: a PCIe device with BAR0/BAR2/BAR4 and TLB translation, a 17x12 dual NoC mesh, 140 Tensix nodes with 980 RV32IMC cores and a Tensix coprocessor model covering about 200 instructions, ARC firmware and telemetry. A guest Linux runs the real tt-kmd and tt-metal on it, and all tt-metal programming examples and the LLK and SFPI unit tests pass. The QEMU device patches and the RV32 instruction-set emulator live in companion repositories.
author: itisme
